article.title: Registro de diminutivos
article.chapter: Diminutivos, expresividad y registro — Уменьшительные формы, экспрессивность и регистр

claims.summary: Trubnikova analyzes Russian diminutive forms through politeness and speech-act theory and reports that perceived appropriateness varies with social distance and power; the entry is narrowed to this situational variability, not a universal register rule.
